newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange to list cola producer Kristal.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange to list cola producer Kristal.

text.p: Istanbul Stock Exchange said it would list part of the shares of Turkish soft drinks and drinking water producer Kristal Kola ve Mesrubat Sanayi A.S. on the national market on Tuesday.
The opening price will be 10,000 lira per 1,000 lira nominal valued share, the Exchange said in a statement.

The company floated 200 billion lira, or 16.67 percent of its capital, at the same price in a two-day public offer two weeks ago. The parent company Ihlas Holding holds a 61.67-percent stake in the company after the offer.

The statement said 168.79 billion lira of of the total offered shares, or 84.40 percent, were sold to domestic investors, 11.21 billion lira of shares were sold to investors abroad and 20.00 billion lira to Ihlas Holding employees.
The company announced on Monday that its first half net profit was 377.85 billion lira, but no comparison was available for its profits in the same 1996 same period.
